A2TTA：针对不断发展的交通传感器网络的锚定和敏捷测试时间适应TTA: Anchored-and-Agile Test-Time Adaptation for Evolving Traffic Sensor Networks

Du Yin du.yin@unsw.edu.au University of New South WalesSydneyNSWAustralia HKUST(GZ)China , Xiachong Lin dawn.lin@student.unsw.edu.au University of New South WalesSydneyNSWAustralia , Yue Tan yue.tan@griffith.edu.au Griffith UniversityBrisbaneQueenslandAustralia , Jinliang Deng dengjinliang@ust.hk Beihang UniversityBeijingChina , Estrid He estrid.he@rmit.edu.au RMIT UniversityMelbourneVICAustralia , Hao Xue hao.xue1@unsw.edu.au University of New South WalesSydneyNSWAustralia HKUST(GZ)China and Flora Salim flora.salim@unsw.edu.au University of New South WalesSydneyNSWAustralia
(2027)
摘要。Abstract.

交通预测对于智慧城市的高效交通管理和路线规划非常重要。 现有的交通预测研究通常假设固定的传感器图，忽视了现实世界交通网络的持续演变，例如正在进行的道路网络建设和不断发展的人类流动模式。 这些动态变化可能会大大降低传统预测模型的性能，从而促使测试时间适应 (TTA) 在部署期间有效地适应预训练模型。 然而，将 TTA 应用于不断发展的交通传感器网络在两个方面仍然具有挑战性。 首先，拓扑扩展引入了新的传感器和连接，不断重塑传感器图。 其次，时间变化的时间尺度和稳定性各不相同，需要对长期和短期变化进行差异化的适应。 在这项研究中，我们通过提出解决这些挑战Traffic forecasting is important for efficient traffic management and route planning in smart cities. Existing traffic forecasting studies typically assume fixed sensor graphs, overlooking the continuous evolution of real-world traffic networks, e.g., ongoing road network construction and evolving human mobility patterns. These dynamic changes can substantially degrade conventional forecasting models, motivating test-time adaptation (TTA) to efficiently adapt pretrained models during deployment. However, applying TTA to evolving traffic sensor networks remains challenging in two aspects. First, topology expansion introduces new sensors and connections, continuously reshaping the sensor graph. Second, temporal shifts vary in time scale and stability, requiring differentiated adaptation to long-term and short-term shifts. In this study, we address these challenges by proposingA2塔塔TTA, 一个, anA锚定-并-nchored-and-A吉勒gileT预计-est-T伊姆imeA用于不断发展的交通传感器网络的适应框架，它将拓扑引起的预测误差转化为可扩展的输出校准问题，并将时间适应分为持久的全局校正和敏捷的特定于上下文的专业化。 通过联合解决拓扑演化和多尺度时间变化，daptation framework for evolving traffic sensor networks, which transforms topology-induced forecasting errors into an expandable output calibration problem and separates temporal adaptation into persistent global correction and agile context-specific specialization. By jointly addressing topology evolution and multi-scale temporal shifts, A2TTA 能够高效、稳健地适应不断变化的交通环境。 对十个现实世界交通网络的大量实验表明TTA enables efficient and robust adaptation to continuously evolving traffic environments. Extensive experiments on ten real-world traffic networks demonstrate that A2TTA 持续改进不同主干网、数据集和预测范围的预测性能。 我们的代码可在TTA consistently improves forecasting performance across different backbones, datasets, and prediction horizons. Our code is available inhttps://anonymous.4open.science/r/A2TTA.

1. 简介Introduction

交通预测对于建设智慧城市和智能交通系统至关重要，通过支持高效的交通管理和路线规划来帮助缓解拥堵并改善流动性Traffic forecasting is vital for building smart cities and intelligent transportation systems, helping alleviate congestion and improve mobility by supporting efficient traffic management and route planning(Chen and Liang, 2025a; Shao et al., 2022a; Wu et al., 2019; Yu et al., 2018; Zhang et al., 2025)。 通常，现有的交通预测研究建立在固定的传感器图上，其中节点代表部署在特定位置的交通传感器，边缘表征道路网络的空间连通性。 为了对复杂的时空交通动态进行建模并准确预测未来的交通状态，例如交通流、速度和需求，已经开发了各种数据驱动的方法，通常遵循交通数据收集、图构建、时空建模和未来状态预测的工作流程。 该管道极大地拓宽了交通预测可支持的下游应用范围，例如拥堵管理、路线规划和交通控制等。. Usually, existing traffic forecasting studies are built upon fixed sensor graphs, where nodes represent traffic sensors deployed at specific locations and edges characterize the spatial connectivity of road networks. To model complex spatio-temporal traffic dynamics and accurately predict future traffic states, e.g., traffic flow, speed, and demand, various data-driven methods have been developed, typically following a workflow of traffic data collection, graph construction, spatio-temporal modeling, and future-state prediction. This pipeline has substantially broadened the range of downstream applications that traffic forecasting can support, such as congestion management, route planning, and traffic control, etc.

传统方法通常假设静态交通网络，遵循一次训练即部署的范例，其中训练后的模型预计将在很长一段时间内保持有效Traditional methods generally assume a static traffic network, following a train-once-and-deploy paradigm where the trained model is expected to remain effective in a long period(Guo et al., 2019; Jiang et al., 2023; Shao et al., 2022b; Jiang et al., 2021)。 不幸的是，这种假设在实践中很少成立，因为现实世界的交通传感器网络随着时间的推移不断发展。 一方面，道路网络不断建设和更新，导致新传感器的部署和过时传感器的拆除。与此同时，持续的城市化重塑了道路布局和连通性，进一步改变了底层的传感器图。 另一方面，由于通勤行为、人口分布和交通政策的变化，人类流动模式也会随着时间的推移而演变，即使道路拓扑保持不变，也会导致交通动态的变化。 在这些情况下，传统的“一次训练即部署”预测模型可能会遭受严重的性能下降，因为底层传感器图和交通动态逐渐偏离训练期间观察到的情况。 为了处理上述动态变化，一个简单的解决方案是定期训练模型。然而，再培训的成本可能很高，并且可能会用短暂的模式覆盖有用的知识。 在这种情况下，一个有前途的解决方案是测试时间适应（TTA），它根据部署期间观察到的数据更新预训练模型. Unfortunately, this assumption rarely holds in practice, as real-world traffic sensor networks continuously evolve over time. On the one hand, road networks undergo continuous construction and renewal, leading to the deployment of new sensors and the removal of outdated ones. Meanwhile, ongoing urbanization reshapes road layouts and connectivity, further altering the underlying sensor graph. On the other hand, human mobility patterns also evolve over time due to changes in commuting behavior, population distribution, and transportation policies, resulting in shifts in traffic dynamics even when the road topology remains unchanged. In these cases, conventional train-once-and-deploy forecasting models may suffer from substantial performance degradation, as both the underlying sensor graph and traffic dynamics progressively shift away from those observed during training. To handle the above dynamic changes, a straightforward solution is to regularly train the model. However, retraining can be expensive and may overwrite useful knowledge with short-lived patterns. Under this circumstance, a promising solution is Test-Time Adaptation (TTA), which updates a pretrained model from data observed during deployment(Guo et al., 2024; Wang et al., 2021)，而不是从头开始重新训练模型。 因此，TTA 保持了适应效率，同时有效地重用了预训练主干中编码的知识。, rather than retraining the model from scratch. As a result, TTA maintains adaptation efficiency while effectively reusing the knowledge encoded in the pretrained backbone.

尽管 TTA 潜力巨大，但由于以下两个挑战，现有的普通 TTA 解决方案无法有效处理不断变化的流量预测问题。 一项关键挑战是Despite the strong potential of TTA, existing vanilla TTA solutions fail to effectively handle the evolving traffic forecasting problem due to the following two challenges. One key challenge is挑战1——拓扑扩展Challenge 1 - Topology Expansion。与固定输入空间中发生的传统分布变化不同，不断发展的交通网络表现出节点集和图结构的持续扩展。 具体来说，新传感器的部署将以前未见过的节点和连接引入到图中，这改变了现有节点的局部邻域并重塑了局部图结构和空间依赖性。 传统的 TTA 方法很难处理这种拓扑级别的变化，因为它们通常被设计为适应一组固定节点和预定义的图拓扑上的变化，缺乏捕获动态结构变化的能力。. Unlike conventional distribution shifts that occur in a fixed input space, evolving traffic networks exhibit continuous expansion of both the node set and the graph structure. Specifically, the deployment of new sensors introduces previously unseen nodes and connections into the graph, which alters the local neighborhoods of existing nodes and reshapes local graph structures and spatial dependencies. It is hard for conventional TTA methods to deal with such topology-level shift since they are typically designed to adapt to shifts over a fixed set of nodes and a predefined graph topology, lacking the ability to capture dynamic structural changes.

除了拓扑扩展之外，随着时间的推移不断演变的人类流动模式引入了另一个关键挑战，称为In addition to topology expansion, evolving human mobility patterns over time introduce another key challenge, termed挑战 2 - 时间分布变化Challenge 2 - Temporal Distribution Shift。 由于人类行为的周期性和不规则波动，测试时遇到的输入输出关系和时空模式可能会偏离训练期间学到的内容。 例如，人口、道路基础设施或交通政策的长期变化可能会导致整体交通特征多年来发生长期变化。 相反，临时事件或意外事件可能会导致短期的、特定环境的变化，这些变化高度依赖于特定的时间和环境条件。 图中. Due to periodic and irregular fluctuations in human behavior, the input-output relationships and spatio-temporal patterns encountered at test time can deviate from those learned during training. For example, long-lasting changes in population, road infrastructure, or transportation policies may induce long-term shifts to the overall traffic characteristics over years. In contrast, temporary events or unexpected incidents may cause short-term, context-specific shifts that are highly dependent on the specific temporal and environmental conditions. In Figure1(a，b)，我们展示了这种不断发展的部署设置，并分别显示了随着拓扑扩展而出现的持续漂移和瞬态偏差。 此外，只有在预测范围过去后，标签才可用于适应。 在这种情况下，这一挑战不仅在于适应时间变化，还在于识别具有不同时间尺度和稳定性程度的不同类型的时间变化，并相应地应用适当的持续校正和适应策略。(a, b), we exhibit this evolving deployment setting and show the persistent drift and transient deviations alongside topology expansion, respectively. Also, labels become available for adaptation only after the forecasting horizon has elapsed. In this case, this challenge lies not only in adapting to temporal shifts, but in identifying distinct types of temporal shifts with varying time scales and degrees of stability, and applying appropriate persistent corrections.adaptation strategies accordingly.

为了应对上述挑战，我们建议To address the above challenges, we proposeA锚定-并-nchored-and-A吉勒gileT预计-est-T伊姆imeA适应（daptation (A2塔塔TTA简称）用于不断发展的交通传感器网络。 如图所示for short) for evolving traffic sensor networks. As illustrated in Figure3, 一个, A2TTA 将两种互补的设计结合在一起。 处理TTA couples two complementary designs. To handle挑战1Challenge 1，我们将一个可扩展且节点调节的 FiLM 校准器附加到冻结的主干上，该校准器通过调节最近的节点观察、时间统计和可扩展的节点嵌入来校正基本预测。 致地址, we attach an expandable and node-conditioned FiLM calibrator to the frozen backbone, which corrects the base forecast by conditioning on recent node observations, temporal statistics, and an expandable node embedding. To address挑战2Challenge 2，我们维持两个在不同时间尺度上运行的互补校准器状态。 对于持续的长期变化，使用反馈池中保留的所有因果释放样本不断更新锚定全局校准器，并针对其预热状态进行正则化。 同时，对于特定于上下文的短期偏差，敏捷的本地克隆专门使用按时间阶段、流量模式相似性和新近度加权的已发布样本。 为了防止瞬态上下文污染持久全局状态，克隆用于单个预测，然后被丢弃。 通过这些互补的设计，, we maintain two complementary calibrator states that operate at different temporal scales. For persistent long-term shifts, an anchored global calibrator is continually updated using all causally released samples retained in the feedback pool and regularized toward its warm-up state. Meanwhile, for context-specific short-term deviations, an agile local clone is specialized using released samples weighted by temporal phase, traffic-pattern similarity, and recency. To prevent transient contexts from contaminating the persistent global state, the clone is used for a single prediction and then discarded. Through these complementary designs, A2TTA 支持拓扑感知和时间自适应预测，为不断发展的交通传感器网络中的预测提供高效且强大的解决方案。TTA enables topology-aware and temporally adaptive forecasting, providing an efficient and robust solution for forecasting in continuously evolving traffic sensor networks.

我们的主要贡献总结如下：Our main contributions are summarized as follows:

  • •

    我们将不断发展的传感器网络的流量预测制定为因果延迟反馈适应问题，同时考虑拓扑扩展和多尺度时间分布变化。We formulate traffic forecasting on evolving sensor networks as a causal delayed-feedback adaptation problem, jointly considering topology expansion and multi-scale temporal distribution shifts.

  • •

    我们建议AWe propose A2TTA，一种轻量级且与骨干网无关的框架，可将节点异构预测误差转换为可扩展的基于 FiLM 的输出校准问题，同时保持预测 脊椎骨冻结了。TTA, a lightweight and backbone-agnostic framework that converts node-heterogeneous forecasting errors into an expandable FiLM-based output calibration problem while keeping the forecasting backbone frozen.

  • •

    我们开发了一种锚定且敏捷的适应机制，该机制将用于长期漂移的持久全局校准器与用于瞬时偏差的一次性、上下文专用的本地克隆相结合。 EvoXXLTraffic 和 TFNSW 上的大量实验证明了跨主干网、数据集和预测范围的一致改进。We develop an anchored-and-agile adaptation mechanism that combines a persistent global calibrator for long-term drift with a disposable, context-specialized local clone for transient deviations. Extensive experiments on EvoXXLTraffic and TFNSW demonstrate consistent improvements across backbones, datasets, and forecasting horizons.

2. 相关工作Related Work

流量预测从统计时间序列模型发展而来Traffic forecasting has progressed from statistical time-series models(Box et al., 2015; Williams and Hoel, 2003)深入的时间和图形架构。代表性时空图神经网络 (STGNN) 将循环算子、卷积算子或扩散算子与道路网络结构相结合to deep temporal and graph architectures. Representative spatio-temporal graph neural networks (STGNNs) combine recurrent, convolutional, or diffusion operators with road-network structure(Zhao et al., 2019; Yu et al., 2018; Li et al., 2018)，而后来的方法学习自适应图或基于注意力的空间依赖性, while later methods learn adaptive graphs or attention-based spatial dependencies(Wu et al., 2019; Zheng et al., 2020; Xu et al., 2020)。 STID和STAEFormer等最新架构进一步提高了预测效率和准确性. Recent architectures such as STID and STAEFormer further improve forecasting efficiency and accuracy(Shao et al., 2022a; Liu et al., 2023)。尽管这些方法可以对复杂甚至自适应的空间依赖性进行建模，但它们通常是在固定的传感器宇宙下开发和评估的。相反，我们的设置考虑了多年部署，其中添加传感器、图形拓扑变化和流量分布同时漂移。. Although these methods can model complex and even adaptive spatial dependencies, they are generally developed and evaluated under a fixed sensor universe. Our setting instead considers multi-year deployment in which sensors are added, graph topology changes, and traffic distributions drift simultaneously.

除了固定图预测之外，在线连续方法还通过重播、模式记忆、本地化更新或可扩展提示来解决网络演进问题Beyond fixed-graph forecasting, online and continual approaches address network evolution through replay, pattern memories, localized updates, or expandable prompts(Chen et al., 2021; Wang et al., 2023b, a; Chen and Liang, 2025a)。检索和测试时间校准方法使用历史模式或流统计进一步调整预测. Retrieval and test-time calibration methods further adapt predictions using historical patterns or streaming statistics(Zhang et al., 2025; Chen and Liang, 2025b)。然而，现有方法通常更新大量的预测组件，依赖于显式重放或模式记忆，或者关注固定节点集上的时间漂移​​。一个. However, existing approaches typically update substantial forecasting components, rely on explicit replay or pattern memories, or focus on temporal drift over a fixed node set. A2TTA 采用了不同的路线：它冻结了预测主干，引入了可扩展的节点条件 FiLM 校准器，并将因果适应分离为持久的全局状态和一次性的上下文专用本地克隆。这两个州都只使用在完整的预测范围过后发布的标签。附录中提供了更完整的评论TTA takes a different route: it freezes the forecasting backbone, introduces an expandable node-conditioned FiLM calibrator, and separates causal adaptation into a persistent global state and a disposable context-specialized local clone. Both states use only labels released after the complete forecasting horizon has elapsed. A more complete review is provided in AppendixA.2.

4. 问题表述Problem Formulation

6. 实验Experiments

6.1. 实验设置Experimental Settings

每年使用按时间顺序 60%/20%/20% 的训练/验证/测试划分。 PEMS 窗口包含 12 个五分钟步数，TFNSW 窗口包含 12 个每小时步数 步骤。所有方法共享图形快照、分割、测试窗口和指标 代码。标准化仅使用训练统计数据；验证和测试目标 不进入预处理。Each year uses a chronological 60%/20%/20% train/validation/test split. PEMS windows contain 12 five-minute steps and TFNSW windows contain 12 hourly steps. All methods share the graph snapshots, splits, test windows, and metric code. Normalization uses training statistics only; validation and test targets do not enter preprocessing.

在线方法一次处理一个时间窗口，通过以下方式匹配节点 元数据传感器 ID，并在 12 个步骤后释放每个目标。一个Online methods process one chronological window at a time, match nodes by metadata sensor IDs, and release each target after 12 steps. A2TTA 保留 512 个窗口发布并每 64 个窗口更新一次其全局状态。静态 方法接收相同的窗口而没有测试标签。我们报告累计 平均绝对误差 (MAE)、均方根误差 (RMSE) 和平均绝对误差 第 3、6 和 12 层的百分比误差 (MAPE)。Avg 是累积值的平均值 从水平 1 到水平 12 的分数，以 Avg-MAE 作为主要指标。结果使用 除非另有说明，否则五对种子。TTA keeps 512 released windows and updates its global state every 64 windows. Static methods receive the same windows without test labels. We report cumulative mean absolute error (MAE), root mean square error (RMSE), and mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) at horizons 3, 6, and 12. Avg averages the cumulative scores from horizons 1 to 12, with Avg-MAE as the primary metric. Results use five paired seeds unless noted otherwise.

7. 局限性Limitations

A2TTA 假设标签最终到达并使用带标签的训练 分区来为每个年度快照预热校准器。主要设定 因此不涵盖完全无标签部署。新传感器群体 包含在今年的训练分区中观察到的传感器，并且应该 不能被解释为零次节点调试。无需预热的控制 附录TTA assumes that labels eventually arrive and uses a labeled training partition to warm up the calibrator for each yearly snapshot. The main setting therefore does not cover fully label-free deployment. The new-sensor cohort contains sensors observed in the current year’s training partition and should not be interpreted as zero-shot node commissioning. A warm-up-free control in AppendixA.6明确地衡量这种依赖性。的 评估仅限于单变量交通流量、年度图表变化以及 两个预测支柱。绝对延迟和内存还取决于 部署硬件和图形大小。measures this dependence explicitly. The evaluation is limited to univariate traffic flow, yearly graph changes, and two forecasting backbones. Absolute latency and memory also depend on the deployment hardware and graph size.

8. 结论Conclusion

我们研究了对不断变化的传感器图的预测作为因果延迟反馈适应，并引入了 AWe studied forecasting on evolving sensor graphs as causal delayed-feedback adaptation and introduced A2TTA，一种输出校准器，可保持每个匹配的年度冻结预报器。其可扩展的 FiLM 模块支持节点增长，而持久的全局和一次性本地状态则解决长期且特定于上下文的转变。锚定的全局状态从发布的标签中学习持续的变化，而一次性的本地克隆专门针对当前上下文，并在预测后被丢弃。根据对九个 EvoXXLTraffic 区和 TFNSW 的单一窗口时间顺序评估，ATTA, an output calibrator that keeps each matched yearly frozen forecaster. Its expandable FiLM module supports node growth, while persistent global and disposable local states address long-lived and context-specific shifts. The anchored global state learns persistent shifts from released labels, while a disposable local clone specializes to the current context and is discarded after prediction. Under one-windows chronological evaluation on nine EvoXXLTraffic districts and TFNSW, A2TTA 改进了每个数据集上匹配的主机预测器。相对于相应的骨干网，第 3、6 和 12 层的平均 MAE 降低范围为 9.7% 至 13.2%。一个TTA improves both matched host forecasters on every dataset. Relative to the corresponding backbones, mean MAE reductions at horizons 3, 6, and 12 range from 9.7% to 13.2%. A2TTA 还改进了元数据定义的新传感器群组。使用 STAEFormer，它平均更新 33.2K 校准器参数，同时保持 206 万参数主干不变，每个测试窗口增加 1.12ms。TTA also improves the metadata-defined new-sensor cohorts. With STAEFormer, it updates 33.2K calibrator parameters on average while leaving the 2.06M-parameter backbone unchanged, adding 1.12 ms per test window.

附录AAppendix A附录Appendix

A.1. 结构演化细节Structural Evolution Details

节点数本身并不能表征这种演变。 图Node counts alone do not characterize this evolution. Figure11因此跟踪平均节点度和图 年度快照的密度。两个量都非单调变化， 因为传感器的添加和移除会改变当地社区和场景 的空间联系。因此，连续的快照在两者上都不同 维度和连接性，而不是简单的零填充扩展 上图的。therefore tracks average node degree and graph density for the yearly snapshots. Both quantities change non-monotonically, because sensor additions and removals alter local neighborhoods and the set of spatial connections. Successive snapshots consequently differ in both dimension and connectivity, rather than being simple zero-padded extensions of the preceding graph.

A.2. 扩展相关工作Extended Related Work

A.2.1。A.2.1.时空交通预测Spatio-Temporal Traffic Forecasting

交通预测，包括交通流量、速度和拥堵状态，一直是计算城市和智能交通系统中最重要的问题之一。早期的流量预测方法主要依靠统计建模和传统的机器学习方法，例如历史平均（HA）、自回归综合移动平均（ARIMA）Traffic forecasting, including traffic flow, speed, and congestion status, has always been one of the most important issues in computational urban and intelligent transportation systems. Early traffic forecasting methods primarily relied on statistical modeling and traditional machine learning methods, such as Historical Average (HA), Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA)(Box et al., 2015), 季节性 ARIMA, Seasonal ARIMA(Williams and Hoel, 2003), 卡尔曼滤波, Kalman filtering(Kumar, 2017), 向量自回归 (VAR), Vector Autoregression (VAR)(Schimbinschi et al., 2017)，支持向量回归（SVR）, Support Vector Regression (SVR)(Wu et al., 2004), 和, andkk-最近邻 (kNN)-Nearest Neighbors (kNN)(Cai et al., 2016)。这些方法通常将流量序列视为一维或低维时间序列，并通过对历史观测中的趋势、周期性和短期自相关进行建模来进行预测。其中，HA采用历史同期平均值作为预测，简单高效，但难以适应突然的变化。 ARIMA 及其变体可以表征线性时间依赖性和周期性模式，但通常依赖于平稳性假设。卡尔曼滤波适用于在线状态估计和短期预测，而SVR和kNN通过非线性映射或相似模式匹配来提高预测能力。然而，这些方法主要依赖于手动特征设计，并且难以同时表征道路网络内复杂的非线性时间变化和空间依赖性。. These methods typically treat traffic sequences as one-dimensional or low-dimensional time series and make predictions by modeling trends, periodicity, and short-term autocorrelation in historical observations. Among them, HA uses historical averages over the same period as predictions, making it simple and efficient but difficult to adapt to sudden changes. ARIMA and its variants can characterize linear temporal dependence and periodic patterns but usually rely on stationarity assumptions. Kalman filtering is suitable for online state estimation and short-term forecasting, while SVR and kNN improve predictive capability through nonlinear mapping or similar-pattern matching. Nevertheless, these methods mostly rely on manual feature design and struggle to characterize complex nonlinear temporal variations and spatial dependencies within road networks simultaneously.

深度流量预测使用了卷积神经网络 (CNN)、循环神经网络 (RNN)、图神经网络 (GNN)、Transformers 以及最近的状态空间模型。早期的时间模型使用长短期记忆 (LSTM) 或门控循环单元 (GRU) 网络来捕获长程依赖性。 CNNDeep traffic forecasting has used convolutional neural networks (CNNs), recurrent neural networks (RNNs), graph neural networks (GNNs), Transformers, and, more recently, state-space models. Early temporal models used long short-term memory (LSTM) or gated recurrent unit (GRU) networks to capture long-range dependencies. CNNs(Shih et al., 2019)和时间卷积网络（TCN）and temporal convolutional networks (TCNs)(Van Den Oord et al., 2016)后来改进了并行性，同时保留了局部时间结构。然后，图模型使道路网络依赖性变得明确。代表性方法包括T-GCNlater improved parallelism while retaining local temporal structure. Graph models then made road-network dependencies explicit. Representative methods include T-GCN(Zhao et al., 2019),STGCN, STGCN(Yu et al., 2018)和 DCRNN, and DCRNN(Li et al., 2018)。 T-GCN 将图卷积置于 GRU 单元内，STGCN 结合了图卷积和时间卷积，DCRNN 通过扩散卷积和编码器-解码器架构对定向传播进行建模。 GNN 也已应用于区域多模式需求预测：Ma 等人。. T-GCN places graph convolution inside GRU units, STGCN combines graph and temporal convolutions, and DCRNN models directed propagation with diffusion convolution and an encoder-decoder architecture. GNNs have also been applied to regional multimodal demand forecasting: Ma et al.(Ma et al., 2022)发布纽约市出租车自行车数据集并研究多源、多图和元信息增强的 STGNN。相反，我们的设置涉及传感器图，其节点和连接随着时间的推移而变化。release an NYC taxi-bike dataset and study multi-source, multi-graph, and meta-information-enhanced STGNNs. Our setting instead concerns sensor graphs whose nodes and connectivity change over time.

此后，流量预测模型朝着自适应图学习、注意力机制和大规模序列建模的方向发展。图波网Traffic forecasting models have since developed toward adaptive graph learning, attention mechanisms, and large-scale sequence modeling. Graph WaveNet(Wu et al., 2019)例如，通过学习自适应空间依赖性来减少对预定义邻接矩阵的依赖。 ASTGCN, for example, reduces reliance on predefined adjacency matrices by learning adaptive spatial dependencies. ASTGCN(Guo et al., 2019)、GMAN, GMAN(Zheng et al., 2020)和 STTN, and STTN(Xu et al., 2020)引入时空注意力来动态建模传感器和时间步长之间的关系。基于变压器的模型因其长序列建模能力而被广泛使用，而状态空间模型为大规模预测提供了线性复杂度的替代方案。这一发展产生了许多强大的模型，包括 MTMGNNintroduce spatio-temporal attention to dynamically model relationships among sensors and time steps. Transformer-based models are now widely used because of their long-sequence modeling capability, while state-space models offer linear-complexity alternatives for large-scale forecasting. This development has produced many strong models, including MTMGNN(Yin et al., 2023),STQCL, STQCL(Yin et al., 2024), STAE前身, STAEFormer(Liu et al., 2023), STID (Shao et al., 2022a), HIM网, HIMNet(Dong et al., 2024), PDF格式器, PDFormer(Jiang et al., 2023)，和自动STF, and AutoSTF(Lyu et al., 2025).

尽管在静态基准方面取得了进展，但大多数现有方法都假设传感器组和道路网络拓扑在训练和测试之间保持不变。然而，在实际部署中，传感器网络会随着时间的推移而扩展，新的传感器会投入使用，连接和流量模式也会发生变化。因此，部署的预测器不仅面临更长的时间序列，而且面临不断变化的流量图。由此产生的节点增长、拓扑变化和时间分布转移挑战模型是在固定图假设下构建的。Despite their progress on static benchmarks, most existing methods assume that the sensor set and road-network topology remain unchanged between training and testing. In real deployments, however, sensor networks expand over time, new sensors are commissioned, and connectivity and traffic patterns drift. A deployed forecaster therefore faces not merely a longer time series but a continuously evolving traffic graph. The resulting node growth, topology change, and temporal distribution shift challenge models built under a fixed-graph assumption.

A.2.2。A.2.2.在线和持续的交通预测Online and Continual Traffic Forecasting

因此，长期的交通系统部署促进了在线和持续的预测。新的传感器不断添加，而现有节点的流量模式随着时间的推移而演变。因此，有效的模型必须获取新的时空模式，而不会灾难性地忘记以前学到的知识。Long-term traffic-system deployment has consequently motivated online and continual forecasting. New sensors are repeatedly added, while traffic patterns at existing nodes evolve over time. An effective model must therefore acquire new spatio-temporal patterns without catastrophically forgetting previously learned knowledge.

交通流TrafficStream(Chen et al., 2021)是将网络扩展和模式演化形式化为流式持续学习问题的首批方法之一。它使用局部子图来集成新传感器的邻域信息，使用 Jensen-Shannon 散度来检测现有节点的漂移，并使用参数平滑的历史重放来减轻灾难性遗忘。遵循显式记忆方法，PECPMwas among the first methods to formalize network expansion and pattern evolution as a streaming continual-learning problem. It uses local subgraphs to integrate neighborhood information for new sensors, Jensen–Shannon divergence to detect drift at existing nodes, and historical replay with parameter smoothing to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. Following an explicit-memory approach, PECPM(Wang et al., 2023b)维护一个具有代表性的时空模式库，并在新图到达时仅更新新的或冲突的节点。 STKECmaintains a library of representative spatio-temporal patterns and updates only new or conflicting nodes when a new graph arrives. STKEC(Wang et al., 2023a)选择有影响力的旧节点来构建局部子图，将它们与长期周期性模式的记忆库结合起来，并通过参数距离正则化保留先验知识。为了降低更新成本，EACselects influential old nodes to construct local subgraphs, combines them with a memory bank for long-term periodic patterns, and preserves prior knowledge through parameter-distance regularization. To reduce update cost, EAC(Chen and Liang, 2025a)使用连续的提示池来表示不同阶段的知识，并遵循扩展压缩策略，避免整个模型的大规模更新。短时血压uses a continual prompt pool to represent knowledge from different stages and follows an expansion–compression strategy that avoids large-scale updates of the whole model. STBP(Liu and Zhang, 2026)冻结一般的时空主干，仅扩展可扩展的上下文模式库，平衡稳定性和可塑性。斯蒂夫freezes a general spatio-temporal backbone and expands only a scalable contextual pattern library, balancing stability and plasticity. STEV(Ma et al., 2025)将新传感器视为变量扩展问题，并使用扁平化方案来提高对不同输入规模的鲁棒性。表带treats new sensors as a variable-expansion problem and uses a flattening scheme to improve robustness to varying input scales. STRAP(Zhang et al., 2025)构建外部模式库并在推理时检索相似的模式作为提示。 ST-TTCconstructs an external pattern library and retrieves similar patterns as prompts at inference time. ST-TTC(Chen and Liang, 2025b)通过频域对齐和流内存队列执行测试时间校准，但主要解决固定节点集中的时间漂移。performs test-time calibration with frequency-domain alignment and streaming memory queues, but primarily addresses temporal drift within a fixed node set.

与更新大量模型组件或依赖于大型重播存储器的方法不同，我们仅采用附加到冻结预测器的残差校准器。记录仍处于待处理状态，直到其完整的预测范围结束。发布的记录更新全局校准器，本地克隆根据时间阶段、流量模式相似性和新近度对保留池进行加权。此设计可以处理节点增长、拓扑变化和流量漂移，而无需更新已部署的预测骨干网。Unlike methods that update substantial model components or depend on large replay memories, we adapt only a residual calibrator attached to a frozen forecaster. Records remain pending until their complete forecast horizon has elapsed. Released records update the global calibrator, and the local clone weights the retained pool by temporal phase, traffic-pattern similarity, and recency. This design handles node growth, topology change, and traffic drift without updating the deployed forecasting backbone.

A.4. 漂移严重性分析详细信息Drift-Severity Analysis Details

指标和聚合。Metrics and aggregation.

此辅助诊断使用传统的批量输出。它加入了漂移 测量五粒种子分析中的配对年度误差和一粒种子 用于全网络广度检查的预先指定的种子。 连续多年This auxiliary diagnostic uses legacy batched outputs. It joins drift measurements to paired yearly errors from the five-seed analysis and to one pre-specified seed for the all-network breadth check. For consecutive yearsy−1y-1和andyy，流量分布漂移是 1-两个原始流量的确定性样本之间的 Wasserstein 距离 数组，通过平均标准差进行归一化。图密度漂移是, traffic-distribution drift is the 1-Wasserstein distance between deterministic samples of the two raw traffic arrays, normalized by their average standard deviation. Graph-density drift is|log⁡(δy/δy−1)||\log(\delta_{y}/\delta_{y-1})|, 其中, whereδy\delta_{y}是非零邻接 密度。对于 TFNSW，传感器流失率是根据准确的年度传感器 ID 计算得出的：is the nonzero adjacency density. For TFNSW, sensor churn is computed from exact yearly sensor IDs as(|𝒱y∖𝒱y−1|+|𝒱y−1∖𝒱y|)/|𝒱y∪𝒱y−1|(|\mathcal{V}_{y}\setminus\mathcal{V}_{y-1}|+|\mathcal{V}_{y-1}\setminus\mathcal{V}_{y}|)/|\mathcal{V}_{y}\cup\mathcal{V}_{y-1}|。相应的 PEMS 分析使用保守的净计数下限. The corresponding PEMS analysis uses the conservative net-count lower bound|Ny−Ny−1|/max⁡(Ny,Ny−1)|N_{y}-N_{y-1}|/\max(N_{y},N_{y-1})，因为处理后的实验阵列 用于此诊断的不保留完整的站 ID 转换记录。, because the processed experimental arrays used for this diagnostic do not retain the full station-ID transition record.

为了脊梁骨For a backbonebb，数据集中的相对增益, the relative gain in datasetdd和年份and yearyy is 100​(MAEb,d,y−MAEA2​TTA​(b),d,y)/MAEb,d,y100(\mathrm{MAE}_{b,d,y}-\mathrm{MAE}_{\mathrm{A^{2}TTA}(b),d,y})/\mathrm{MAE}_{b,d,y}。主层首先对每个层内的误差进行平均 五对种子的数据集年份，包含 47 个 Online-AN 和 87 个 STAE以前的年度细胞。四分位数是为每个主干单独形成的 漂移信号。它们的区间是非参数 95% 自举区间 由此产生的年度细胞，而不是种子水平间隔。广度 层使用一个预先指定的种子并覆盖每个相邻年份的 223 个单元 跨越所有十个网络的骨干网。这是一个广度检查而不是 额外的推理层，因此没有误差线。. The primary layer first averages the errors within each dataset-year over the five paired seeds and contains 47 Online-AN and 87 STAEFormer yearly cells. Quartiles are formed separately for each backbone and drift signal. Their intervals are nonparametric 95% bootstrap intervals over the resulting yearly cells, rather than seed-level intervals. The breadth layer uses one pre-specified seed and covers 223 adjacent-year cells per backbone across all ten networks. It is a breadth check rather than an additional inference layer and therefore has no error bars.

A2因此，TTA 可以进入因果流，而无需 校准器预热，但标记的训练分区提供了可测量的 有时还有实质性的好处。我们主要保留三个热身期 协议，并且不要将其呈现为无标签部署。TTA can therefore enter the causal stream without calibrator warm-up, but the labeled training partition provides a measurable and sometimes substantial benefit. We retain three warm-up epochs in the main protocol and do not present it as label-free deployment.

A.10. Mechanism Visualization

图Figure18使用单独的遗留批处理种子 51 PEMS06-2015 Auses a separate legacy-batched seed-51 PEMS06-2015 A2TTA(STAE) diagnostic.它检查学习到的表示 并且不对精度表做出贡献。我们记录内部数量 仅在延迟反馈可用后。对于每个保留的窗户传感器 对，我们从持久全局中提取倒数第二个 FiLM 特征 校准器及其特定环境的一次性克隆。 在拟合一个共享的 Uniform 之前，将两个特征集连接起来 流形逼近和投影（UMAP）。单独的配合将使他们 坐标系无可比拟。对于热图，每个单元格首先求平均值 通过传感器，然后通过预测目标开始的时间窗口 in that clock hour.TTA(STAE) diagnostic. It inspects learned representations and does not contribute to the accuracy tables. We record internal quantities only after delayed feedback is available. For every retained window-sensor pair, we extract the penultimate FiLM features from the persistent global calibrator and its context-specialized disposable clone. The two feature sets are concatenated before fitting one shared Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection (UMAP). Separate fits would make their coordinate systems incomparable. For the heatmaps, each cell first averages over sensors and then over chronological windows whose forecast target begins in that clock hour.

共享投影在两个方面都保留了清晰的时间组织 表示，而本地克隆则产生相对较小的配对 在这个结构内的运动。校正图给出了相同的两阶段 输出空间中的图片：对捕获的流进行平均，全局 校准器通过以下方式更改冻结的预测The shared projection retains a clear time-of-day organization in both representations, while the local clone makes comparatively small paired movements within this structure. The correction maps give the same two-stage picture in output space: averaged over the captured stream, the global calibrator changes the frozen forecast by4.404.40绝对值流量单位， 而本地克隆添加了一个flow units in absolute value, whereas the local clone adds a0.900.90-unit refinement, or 20.4%20.4\%的 全局校正幅度。两次修正都集中在更活跃的领域 白天的情况并随着预测范围的不同而变化。因此，本地克隆的作用 作为对稳定的全球适应的有针对性的调整，而不是取代 它。这种单次运行的可视化是机械性和说明性的。消融和多种子实验提供了定量证据。of the global correction magnitude. Both corrections concentrate in the more active daytime regimes and vary across forecast horizons. Thus, the local clone acts as a targeted adjustment to a stable global adaptation rather than replacing it. This single-run visualization is mechanistic and illustrative. The ablations and multi-seed experiments provide the quantitative evidence.
